userAssetSlots.name: Backgrounds
userAssetSlots.description: Upload still or loopable visual backgrounds; text-safe zones are detected and can be adjusted per target.
guidance: Use high-resolution assets with quiet areas for text.
Video backgrounds must loop cleanly and avoid flashes.

userAssetSlots.name: Overlays and textures
userAssetSlots.description: Upload transparent texture, grain, frame, or motif layers.
guidance: Use transparent PNG or WebP.
Avoid texture under small text.

userAssetSlots.name: Fonts
userAssetSlots.description: Upload locally licensed fonts for a project or brand kit; font files are sanitized and subset for export.
guidance: Confirm embedding and redistribution rights.
Provide Devanagari coverage for Hindi projects when needed.

userAssetSlots.name: Music
userAssetSlots.description: Upload owned or licensed music stems and loops; loudness and looping are analyzed before use.
guidance: Prefer WAV or FLAC masters.
Music is off by default and automatically ducks beneath narration.

userAssetSlots.name: Sound effects
userAssetSlots.description: Upload owned or licensed one-shots, ambiences, and transition cues.
guidance: Avoid harsh transients under narration.
Provide a caption label for meaningful sounds.

userAssetSlots.name: Synthetic presenter portraits
userAssetSlots.description: Upload an original fictional or synthetic character portrait for lip-sync and presenter scenes.
guidance: Use a front-facing, evenly lit image with visible shoulders.
Record the generator, model, prompt provenance, and C2PA state when available.

userAssetSlots.name: Real-person presenter portraits
userAssetSlots.description: Upload a consented real-person portrait with an immutable likeness and distribution consent record.
guidance: Use a front-facing, evenly lit image with visible shoulders.
Consent scope must cover portrait animation, lip-sync, and distribution.

userAssetSlots.name: Presenter clips
userAssetSlots.description: Upload consented presenter footage for compositing or identity-reference workflows.
guidance: Use steady framing and clean speech-free footage where possible.
Consent and distribution scope are checked before export.

userAssetSlots.name: Logos and brand marks
userAssetSlots.description: Upload brand marks with light and dark variants for intros, lower thirds, and credits.
guidance: SVG is sanitized and scripts, remote references, and foreign objects are rejected.
Keep clear-space guidance in the brand kit.

userAssetSlots.name: Lower-third design
userAssetSlots.description: Import a data-only lower-third token preset or a flattened transparent frame.
guidance: Executable templates are not accepted.
Keep text and marks within safe areas.

userAssetSlots.name: Caption style
userAssetSlots.description: Import a closed data-only caption token preset with font, color, placement, and safe-area settings.
guidance: WCAG contrast and collision checks still apply.
One-, two-, and three-line stress samples are validated before use.
